description: The whole trip into one airport in one answer: the flight's extras on an airline (bags, seats, fees, as true_cost) AND what car hire there really costs (Car Rental Brain's measured median per day, car only, dated). Use for 'flying to Faro with Ryanair, bags and a hire car: what will it cost?'. Car only: deposits, second-driver fees and desk cover are not included; the answer links to the airport's full car-hire report.

airline.description: Airline name or IATA code (optional; without it you get car hire only)

airport.description: IATA code or name of the airport you fly INTO, e.g. 'FAO', 'Faro', 'Malaga'

cabin_bag.description: A large cabin bag for the overhead locker (the small under-seat bag is free)

checked_bag_kg.description: Checked bag(s) per person of this weight allowance, e.g. 20 or 23; omit for none

currency.description: Currency of the answer: EUR (default) or GBP, as the airline publishes it

domestic.description: true for a flight within the US: US airlines charge different bag prices there than on international routes

fare.description: Total fare for the whole party, if known

group_bags.description: Checked bags shared by the whole party, fewer than the people (e.g. 1 bag between 2): priced as that many 1st bags; needs checked_bag_kg

hold_bags.description: Checked bags per person (default 1); the 2nd bag often costs more

seat.description: Paid seat choice: none (random seat), standard, or extra (legroom / front)

trip.description: one_way (default) or return: return counts each extra on both flights

name: trip_at_airport
title: Trip at airport
